definition.description: Retrieves customers associated with an indirect reseller from Microsoft Partner Center API. Returns a list of customers with their company profiles and tenant information.

inputFields.helpText: The unique identifier (GUID) of the indirect reseller in Partner Center.
Bearer token for Partner Center API authentication. Typically obtained from an OAuth node.

outputParameters.description: Total number of customers returned by the API
Number of customers in the items array
JSON array of all customer objects (full data)
JSON array of simplified customer info (id, tenantId, companyName, domain, relationship)
The full raw JSON response body
HTTP status code from the API response
True if an error occurred during the request
Error details if the request failed

connectionTags.description: Triggered when customers were successfully retrieved
Triggered when the request fails or returns an error status
